author: Trevor Kearing
title: Traders Sell Shares of Apple (AAPL) on Strength After Analyst Downgrade
text:
Traders sold shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on strength during trading on Wednesday after DA Davidson lowered their price target on the stock to $245.00. $698.52 million flowed into the stock on the tick-up and $985.07 million flowed out of the stock on the tick-down, for a money net flow of $286.55 million out of the stock. Of all stocks tracked, Apple had the 0th highest net out-flow for the day. Apple traded up $0.62 for the day and closed at $153.92
Several other brokerages have also recently weighed in on AAPL. Oppenheimer reaffirmed a “neutral” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, October 1st. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research note on Monday, October 1st. Macquarie reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $235.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, September 27th. Nomura reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and set a $215.00 target price (up previously from $210.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, September 28th. Finally, Vertical Group began coverage on Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. They set a “sell” rating for the company. Three research analysts have twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. The stock has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.33.
Get Apple alerts: In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Corporate insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
Hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently made changes to their positions in the company. Ingalls & Snyder LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 7.3% in the 4th quarter. Ingalls & Snyder LLC now owns 275,905 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $43,521,000 after acquiring an additional 18,735 shares in the last quarter. Mitchell Sinkler & Starr PA lifted its stake in Apple by 1.1% in the 4th quarter. Mitchell Sinkler & Starr PA now owns 8,271 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,305,000 after acquiring an additional 90 shares in the last quarter. Brand Asset Management Group Inc. lifted its stake in Apple by 75.3% in the 4th quarter. Brand Asset Management Group Inc. now owns 1,152 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $182,000 after acquiring an additional 495 shares in the last quarter. V Wealth Advisors LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 0.8% in the 4th quarter. V Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 45,159 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,861,000 after acquiring an additional 354 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Virginia National Bank lifted its stake in Apple by 544.8% in the 4th quarter. Virginia National Bank now owns 24,005 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,786,000 after acquiring an additional 20,282 shares in the last quarter. 57.05% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
The company has a market capitalization of $753.49 billion, a PE ratio of 12.82, a PEG ratio of 1.48 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the business earned $2.07 EPS. As a group, sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.89 EPS for the current year.

Apple Company Profile ( NASDAQ:AAPL )
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
